answer_1.quote: Model editing, also referred to as knowledge updating, involves modifying the behavior of an initial target model on specific edit examples without compromising its performance on unrelated examples.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates answers to factual questions such as 'Who is the President of the United States?' and similar knowledge-intensive queries before and after editing.

answer_2.quote: The objective of the post-edit model f θe is to meet three essential properties: reliability, generality, and locality.
